route:/login.note: Native login screen; username-or-email resolve via /auth/resolve-username.

route:/join.note: Join-org flow; reached via invite deep link

route:/reset-password.note: Must handle the Supabase recovery deep link

route:/.note: AuthGate + five-tab shell; REQUESTOR tab rule matches web Layout.tsx.

route:/requisitions.note: Inbox: day-grouped cards, status tabs from core config, search, sort, pull-to-refresh.

route:/requisitions/new.note: New request form with line items and live total; handles the one-open-request API block.

route:/menu.note: Menu tab: profile, role-gated queues, Other Services grid, sign out. Settings land in P5.

route:/cashbook.note: Wallet carousel, ledger, entry detail, deposit, transfers, wallet/external-account creation, CSV statement import. Pay-link deferred to P5.

route:/approvals.note: Native queue; approve/reject on the requisition detail, gated by core.canAuthoriseRequisition.

route:/disbursements.note: Native queue; payout sheet on the detail screen (cash settles, Lenco returns PROCESSING).

route:/vouchers/:id.note: Journal lines, balance check, post-to-ledger for ACCOUNTANT/ADMIN.

route:/reporting.note: Headline card, Month/Quarter/YTD toggle, grouped category breakdown with budget progress and prior-period change. Trend chart and budget editing stay web-only for now.

route:/intelligence.note: Redesigned to match web exactly: "Business Intelligence" title, Assistant/Data Insights/Automations tab row, matching placeholder screens, composer card matching web shape. Tab bar hides once a chat starts, mirroring web collapsing its own tab row into AssistantChat's back button.

route:/settings.note: Split into three focused screens (profile/general/team) reached from Menu, rather than one tabbed page — matches how the app already navigates.

route:/products.note: List + create/edit for name, type, price, image. Digital assets, delivery options and additional-image carousel stay web-only.

route:/audit.note: Score hero, search, per-transaction rating -> requisition detail.

route:/schedules.note: List with category filter, run-now, and a creation modal covering title/amount/category/cadence/next-due.

route:/onboarding.note: Full signup wizard -- deferred; org creation and activation happen on web today.

route:/pay/:wallet_id.note: Customer payment page; app shares the URL, never renders it

route:/privacy.note: Linked out from Settings (store listing also links here)
